response.query: What stratification scheme (channel type, student-facing vs. others, academic discipline, view-count bins) will reduce selection bias?
response.answer: Stratification by academic discipline and student-facing channels reduces selection bias. High view-count bins also minimize bias. Use diverse academic disciplines for balanced representation.
